title: InternalServerException test drops the diagnostic description
reasoning: The test passes a non-nil message, "boom", to the InternalServerException mapping but intentionally ignores the returned description. Adjacent awsError mapping tests assert that descriptions are preserved, and diagnostic preservation is the main observable value of the awsError payload. A regression that maps InternalServerException to .awsError(code: "server_error", description: nil) would still pass this suite.
recommendation: Assert that the mapped description equals "boom" in oidcInternalServer, matching the coverage style used for InvalidRequestException, UnauthorizedClientException, and unknown errors.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The current test destructures the description as `_`, so Swift Testing has no expectation tied to the diagnostic payload for this case.
suggestedRegressionTest: In oidcInternalServer, bind `let desc` and add `#expect(desc == "boom")`.
